# Improx Tech

> Improx Tech is a global digital engineering firm headquartered in Pune, India. We engineer mission-critical digital systems, modern cloud architectures, enterprise software, and automated artificial intelligence platforms for commercial enterprises worldwide.

## Primary Capabilities & Practices

- [Application Services](https://improxtech.com/services/application-services): Custom enterprise software, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, mobile engineering (iOS & Android), API development, legacy modernization, and 24/7 proactive maintenance.
- [Product Engineering](https://improxtech.com/services/product-engineering): End-to-end product strategy, user experience (UX) and design systems, rapid prototyping, automated QA/testing, CI/CD pipelines, and open-source platform engineering.
- [Technology Services](https://improxtech.com/services/technology-services): Zero-downtime cloud migration (AWS, GCP, Azure), DevSecOps governance, enterprise data engineering, cybersecurity & penetration testing, infrastructure management, and IoT frameworks.
- [AI & Business Intelligence](https://improxtech.com/services/ai-ml): Generative AI implementations, custom LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration, predictive machine learning, and executive BI dashboards.

## Architectural Case Studies & Technical Journal

- [Technical Insights & Blueprints](https://improxtech.com/blog): In-depth engineering playbooks, benchmarks, and architectural designs written by principal architects.
- [Architecting High-Throughput Digital Platforms](https://improxtech.com/blog/architecting-high-throughput-digital-platforms): Event-driven architectures, Kafka streaming, Transactional Outbox pattern, and canary deployment pipelines.
- [Benchmarking Multi-Cloud Kubernetes Latency](https://improxtech.com/blog/benchmarking-multi-cloud-kubernetes-latency): Empirical throughput and latency benchmarks across AWS EKS, GCP GKE, and Azure AKS with Cilium eBPF mesh networking.
- [Enterprise AI Agent Orchestration](https://improxtech.com/blog/enterprise-ai-agent-orchestration-lessons): Deterministic state graphs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Pydantic schema guardrails for production AI.
